title: Adaptive LTS promotion with safety windows and chaos-aware rollback
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Problem: We need a safer, automated path for promoting a model/runtime build into the LTS channel. Current manual promotion exposes us to regressions that are discovered late (post-promotion), causing customer incidents and complex rollbacks. Goal: build an adaptive promotion system that combines time-bound safety windows, canary cohorts, chaos-aware health signals, and an automatic rollback orchestration layer tied into feature-flag gating and migration guards.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Automated promotion workflow can promote a candidate to LTS after passing staged checks; 2) Safety windows prevent promotion outside configured maintenance periods; 3) Chaos signals (from periodic fault-injection experiments) are folded into promotion gating; 4) Auto-rollback can revert promotion within 30 minutes if health degrades beyond thresholds; 5) Promotions and rollbacks are auditable in Console and have associated PR and changelog links.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Design API and policy DSL for promotions (safety window, cohort sizes, weighted health scoring). Phase 2: Implement promotion controller service that orchestrates canary ramps, reads chaos experimentation results, and emits audit events. Phase 3: Integrate with feature-flag service to gate schema migrations and non-backward-compatible flags. Phase 4: Add auto-rollback logic with runbook automation and Slack/Console alerts. Phase 5: End-to-end tests and canary dry-run with a low-risk runtime build.

Docs & runbook: runbook for incident responders and SRE playbook (owner: Tessa White)
risks: 1) Overly conservative gating could delay critical security fixes from entering LTS. 2) Incorrectly tuned chaos signals may produce false positives. 3) Rollback of stateful changes (schema/model checkpoints) requires additional migration logic. Mitigations: allow emergency override with approval flow, calibrate chaos thresholds on historical releases, and require migration compatibility checks before promotion.
test_plan: - Unit tests for policy DSL parser and controller state transitions. - Integration test harness that simulates cohort ramps and injected failures. - End-to-end dry-run promoting a canary build to a test LTS namespace. - Post-promotion smoke tests and automated regression prompts against a curated prompt set.
notes:
- This proposal intentionally separates promotion policy from rollout executor so other teams (Dedicated/Private) can reuse policy.
- Discussed with SRE on 2026-02-25: they requested a 2-hour safety window default and a separate emergency path.
- Triage: prioritize instrumentation and health scoring over UI polish for MVP.
